name: code-review
description: Comprehensive local code review with static analysis, security scanning, dependency auditing, container scanning, and best practices enforcement. v3: Python orchestrates claude -p inside the container — no LLM orchestration, no permission prompts. All analysis is local — only optional Jira ticket creation touches remote systems.

permissions.description: Python orchestrates agents via 'claude -p' inside the container. Host needs docker exec/cp/run for container management. Read(*) for reading reports. These permissions must be present BEFORE starting Claude Code.
